notes.title: Player movement updated and asteroid glitch fix
notes.content:
There is a new option for slowing down player movement speed while holding on default "Space" key, or you can change it to any other keybind in the Settings menu, for better precision movement on some occasions. 

Asteroids will always move properly now, on rare occasions asteroids have moved in an insane speed that was almost impossible to dodge.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Controller support is updated, and now supports in game options: pause,move through pause menu and activate buttons, analog sensitive movement of ship, spell activations.
Controller keybinds added in the settings menu.
The game now supports all types of resolution and monitor scale(16:9,16:10,4:3,5:4,3:2).
Unlockable ships changed, now every new unlocked ship gives passive bonuses, those bonuses increase depending on the difficulty required to obtain the new ship.
Added a button from Upgrade screen to continue back to the game level selection screen.
Fixed a bug that made unlock all ships achievement unreachable.
Fixed description of unlocked ships in the Shipyard.

notes.title: Controller analog support and balancing changes
notes.content:
Energy collection time is increased by 0.3 sec
Difficulty on levels 1-4 are drastically decreased.
To proceed to boss battles you'll need to get a Wood medal, down from Gold. (The plan with the gold medal to unlock the boss was to 
force you to get used to the game, and collect enough upgrade points to advance further, because without upgrades at later stage in the game the game becomes substantial harder. )
Boss 1 difficulty is reduced slightly. 
Enabled controller support. Analog stick sensitive movement. You can use abilities with Controller buttons 1/2/3.
Fixed collision on boss1, it's now much easier to avoid bullets that were hitting the back side of the player ship.
To unlock bonus boss you'll need to finish all bosses on any difficulty level (down from diamond).
To unlock bonus levels you need to finish all levels on gold difficulty or higher.
Fixed unlock all achievements bug (smaller bug fix preventing you to get "all ships unlocked" achievement).
